title: UAAP: Far Eastern U boosts Final Four aspirations, eliminates UE
summary: Far Eastern University eased past University of the East, 94-83 to boost its Final Four aspirations in UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball on Wednesday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
